subtitle: Manage screen access and computer actions.
screenNote: Capture only when you request it. Preview images before sharing.
controlNote: Confirm each action before it runs. Support is currently limited to selected applications.
cameraNote: Camera access is not available in this version.
microphoneNote: Microphone access is not available in this version.
idleNote: Computer actions run after you confirm the exact action.
pausedNote: Computer actions stay paused until you resume them.
toolsNote: Choose a supported window, inspect its controls, and review an action before it runs.
escapeLocal: Press Esc in Asimi to stop
